than 70% of the GI tract will result in severe nutritional and

Th e postoperative period for SBS generally follows three dis-
tinct phases. Th e ﬁ rst period ranges anywhere from 7 to 10 days
and is characterized by extensive ﬂ uid and electrolyte losses
within large volumes of diarrhea. During this phase, patients
are dependent on parenteral nutrition, which not only provides 
required nutrients but manages ﬂ uid and electrolyte balance.
